decision: Separate a read-only IME proof that all native replay presses were processed from actual client result confirmation. Only KDE Firefox post-output cleanup may retain the existing bounded result scope on that proof while returning client-unverified; all mutation, exact field verification, expiry and learning contracts remain unchanged.
reason: Native trace proves cleanup cancels completed replay provenance before a delayed final actual snapshot, causing reverse-toggle authority refusal. Waiting-only and client forwarded-release experiments failed native acceptance and remain rejected. Preserve a completed effect for later actual confirmation instead of cancelling it or pretending dispatch is success.
verification: Before editing, record the exact first failed transition and source map. Source semantics must distinguish incomplete native input, fully processed input without a client snapshot, and actual client-confirmed success. Check epoch/path/layout/press-count/focus/selection/expiry/pair/cancellation negatives and that reads mutate no state or emit output. Keep existing generic/GNOME cleanup and verifier tests. Then run short native causal controls before longer repeated-toggle/window modes, decoder, held Shift and display/Tab acceptance; retain source/build/loaded/native identities and all failures.
not_tested: Implementation, installation and native acceptance pending. No route migration, new timer, C03 relaxation, GNOME/Chrome acceptance or public release.
